Package growthbook.sdk.java.multiusermode.internal

Class FeatureRepositoryProvider

java.lang.Object
growthbook.sdk.java.multiusermode.internal.FeatureRepositoryProvider
public final class FeatureRepositoryProvider extends Object
INTERNAL: not part of the supported API. Public only because GrowthBookClient lives in the parent package — treat its signatures as free to change without a major version bump. Provides the feature repository owned by GrowthBookClient.

This class hides lazy repository creation, initialization reuse, failed-initialization retry, and shutdown cleanup from the public client facade.

    • lastInitializationError

      @Nullable public Throwable lastInitializationError()
      Returns:
      the cause of the most recent failed initialization, or null when the last initialization succeeded (or none has run). Used to surface repository init failures in client diagnostics, since initialize() intentionally swallows them.
